description: This file contains utility functions for mapping status strings and arbitrary strings to colors, mainly used in a UI context for consistent color assignment based on status categories. It includes functions to generate deterministic pastel colors from strings and to map known status terms to theme-specific colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings, suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme-specific color. Recognizes common status terms (e.g., 'processing', 'success', 'failed') and defaults to a deterministic color for unknown terms.
